title: Systematic analysis on the mechanism of Zhizi-Bopi decoction against hepatitis B via network pharmacology and molecular docking.
authors: Zhang, He; Xu, Zhouyi; Gao, Haojun; Zhang, Qinyuan
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究栀子柏皮汤抗乙肝机制，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: PURPOSE: Zhizi-Bopi decoction (ZZBPD) is a classic herbal formula with wide clinical applications in treating liver diseases including hepatitis B. However, the mechanism needs to be elucidated. METHODS: Chemical components of ZZBPD were identified by ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with time-of-flight mass spectrometry (UHPLC-TOF-MS). Then we used network pharmacology to identify their potential targets. Network construction, coupled with protein-protein interaction and enrichment analysis was used to identify representative components and core targets. Finally, molecular docking simulation was conducted to further refine the drug-target interaction. RESULTS: One hundred and forty-eight active compounds were identified in ZZBPD, targeting 779 genes/proteins, among which 174 were related to hepatitis B. ZZBPD mainly influences the progression of hepatitis B through the hepatitis B pathway (hsa05161) via core anti-HBV targets (AKT1, PIK3CA, PIK3R1, SRC, TNF, MAPK1, and MAPK3). Enrichment analysis indicated that ZZBPD can also potentially regulate lipid metabolism and enhance cell survival. Molecular docking suggested that the representative active compounds can bind to the core anti-HBV targets with high affinity. CONCLUSION: The potential molecular mechanisms of ZZBPD in hepatitis B treatment were identified using network pharmacology and molecular docking approaches. The results serve as an important basis for the modernization of ZZBPD.
abstract_zh: 目的：栀豉伯皮汤（ZZBPD）是一种经典草药方剂，在治疗包括乙型肝炎在内的肝脏疾病方面具有广泛的临床应用。然而，其作用机制尚需阐明。方法：通过超高效液相色谱-四极杆飞行时间质谱联用（UHPLC-TOF-MS）鉴定了ZZBPD的化学成分。随后，我们利用网络药理学方法识别其潜在靶点。通过构建网络，结合蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用及富集分析，确定了代表性成分和核心靶点。最后，进行分子对接模拟以进一步细化药物-靶点相互作用。结果：在ZZBPD中鉴定出一百四十八种活性化合物，靶向779个基因/蛋白质，其中174个与乙型肝炎相关。ZZBPD主要通过乙型肝炎通路（hsa05161）及核心抗HBV靶点（AKT1、PIK3CA、PIK3R1、SRC、TNF、MAPK1和MAPK3）影响乙型肝炎的进展。富集分析表明，ZZBPD还可能调节脂质代谢并增强细胞存活。分子对接提示，代表性活性化合物能与核心抗HBV靶点高亲和力结合。结论：通过网络药理学和分子对接方法，确定了ZZBPD治疗乙型肝炎的潜在分子机制。这些结果为ZZBPD的现代化提供了重要基础。
